No. 1896/2 – MONDAY, JANUARY 05, 2015
EXTRAORDINARY
LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460) Notice under Section 7
My Ref. No.: KDS/KGK/4/2(1)/2012/10/LA.
I, hereby give notice, under Sub-section (1) of Section 7 of the Land Acquisition Act, that the Government intends to acquire the following Lands which are required for a Public Purpose.
Description of the Lands to be Acquired:

05 Allotments of Land in total Extent of 0.0241 Hectare depicted as Lot No. 01 to 05 in Preliminary Plan No. P. P. Maha 6316 prepared by Surveyor General situated in the Village of Welata and in the Divisional Secretary’s Division of Kandy and Gangawata Korale in Kandy District Central Province:

01. Lot No. 1 — Name of the Land: Palkade Kombura, Assessment No. 595/2, William Gopallawe Mawatha; Original Claimant: Government; Extent: 0.0013 Hectare. North: William Gopallawe Mawatha; East: William Gopallawe Mawatha, Lot No. 7 of P. P. Maha 3696. Lot Nos. 2 & 3 of this Plan; South: Lot No. 2 of this Plan Lot no 8 of P. P. Maha 3696 and Lot No. 04 and 5 of this Plan; West: Lot Nos. 05 of this plan and William Gopallawe Mawatha.
02. Lot No. 2 — Name of the Land: Palkade Kombura, Assessment No. 595/2, William Gopallawe Mawatha; Original Claimant: Government; Extent: 0.0023 Hectare.
North: Lot Nos. 1 and 3 of this Plan; East: Lot 3 of this Plan and lot No. 8 of P. P. Maha 3696; South: Lot No. 8 of P. P. Maha 3696 and Lot No. 1 of this Plan; West: Lot No. 01 of this plan.

03. Lot No. 3 — Name of the Land: Palkade Kombura, Assessment No. 595/2, William Gopallawe Mawatha; Original Claimant: Government; Extent: 0.0013 Hectare. North: Lot No. 1 of this plan William Gopallawe Mawatha and Lot No. 7 of P. P. Maha 3696; East: Lot, No. 7 of P. P. Maha 3696 and Meda Ela; South: Meda Ela Lot No. 8 of P. P. Maha 3696 and Lot No. 2 of this plan. West: Lot No. 8 of P. P. Maha 3696 and Lot No. 1 and 2 of this plan.

04. Lot No. 4 — Name of the Land: Palkade Kombura, Assessment No. 595/2, William Gopallawe Mawatha; Original Claimant: Government; Extent: 0.0032 Hectare. North: Lot No. 1 of this plan and Lot No. 8 of P. P. Maha 3696; East: Meda Ela; South: Meda Ela and Lot No. 5 of this plan. West: Meda Ela and Lot No. 1 and 5 of this plan. 05. All Persons interested in the aforesaid land are hereby required to appear personaly or by agent duly authorized in writing before me at the Divisional Secretariat of Kandy, Four Garments and Gangawata Korale on the 27th day of January 2015 at 10.00 a.m. and are hereby requested to notify me in writing (in Duplicate) on a

before the 14th day of January, 2015 the nature of their interests in the Land, the particulars of their claims for compensation for the acquisition of the said Land and the amount of compensation and the details of the computation of such amount.
D. M. N. G. G. T. KARUNARATNA, Divisional Secretary, Kandy Four Gravets and Gangawata Korale.
